data.long_meaning: The name Airlee is derived from the Old English elements 'æ aer' meaning 'water' and 'leah' meaning 'meadow'. This name invokes images of a peaceful, serene landscape by the water. Airlee is a beautiful name for a baby girl in the Christian tradition. The name Airlee carries the meaning “Meadow by the water” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Airlee usually hope their child will grow to embody meadow by the water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
